title: Pure Vision HERO
summary: Pure Vision HERO deck, utilizing DARK Warrior heroes that can retreat to the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Traps after taking damage or via archetype effects. Emerging from the backrow, they eliminate threats, halve opposing monster stats, and fuel high-impact Fusion Summons.

summary.title: Starters
points: Vision HERO Faris discards another HERO monster from hand to Special Summon itself, and places a Vision HERO monster from your Deck face-up into your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap, locking your Extra Deck into HEROes for the turn.

Vision HERO Increase in the Spell & Trap Zone tributes a HERO monster you control as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself to the Monster Zone, and Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Vision HERO directly from your Deck.
Vision HERO Vyon sends a HERO monster from Deck to GY upon Normal or Special Summon, and banishes a HERO from GY to search Polymerization.
Vision HERO Gravito tributes itself to Special Summon two Vision HERO monsters from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Monster Zone at once, and recovers a banished HERO.

summary.title: Opening: Faris + Increase + Vyon
steps: Activate Vision HERO Faris in hand, discarding another HERO to Special Summon Faris.
Faris triggers on summon to place Vision HERO Increase from your Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap.
Activate Increase's effect in the Spell & Trap Zone, tributing Faris to Special Summon Increase.
Increase triggers on summon to Special Summon Vision HERO Vyon directly from your Deck.
Vyon triggers on summon to send a HERO monster from Deck to GY, then banishes Faris from GY to search Polymerization.
Fuse Increase and Vyon into Vision HERO Adoration (or Link Summon Xtra HERO Wonder Driver).

summary.title: Trap Zone Mechanics & Swarm
points: When you take battle or effect damage, Level 3 and 4 Vision HEROes in your GY (Minimum Ray, Poisoner, Multiply Guy) can place themselves face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Traps.
Vision HERO Minimum Ray destroys an opponent's Level 4 or lower monster when Special Summoned from the Spell & Trap Zone.
Vision HERO Poisoner halves the ATK of 1 face-up monster on the field when Special Summoned from the Spell & Trap Zone.
Vision HERO Multiply Guy gives a face-up monster you control 800 ATK when Special Summoned from the Spell & Trap Zone.
Vision HERO Witch Raider can be Normal Summoned by Tributing Traps you control instead of monsters, and destroys all Spells and Traps the opponent controls on summon.

summary.title: Bosses & Spells
points: Vision HERO Trinity is Fusion Summoned using 3 HERO monsters, doubling its ATK to 5000 during the turn it is summoned and allowing it to attack up to 3 times on monsters.
Vision HERO Adoration is Fusion Summoned using any 2 HERO monsters, targeting an opponent monster and reducing its ATK and DEF by the ATK of another HERO you control.
Destiny HERO - Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer provides recurring Quick Effect destruction and revives itself from the GY each Standby Phase.
Masked HERO Dark Law banishes any card sent to the opponent's GY and randomly banishes a card from their hand when they add a card from Deck to hand.
Xtra HERO Wonder Driver recycles Polymerization or Vision Fusion by setting it directly from your GY when a HERO is Normal or Special Summoned to a zone it points to.
Vision Fusion Fusion Summons a HERO Fusion Monster using materials from hand or field, allowing you to banish monsters from your Spell & Trap Zone as Fusion Material.
Vision Release Special Summons a Vision HERO monster from your Spell & Trap Zone and recovers a Vision HERO from GY.

main: Vision HERO Faris
Discards a HERO to summon itself; places a Vision HERO as a Continuous Trap.
Vision HERO Vyon
Mills a HERO; banishes one to search Polymerization.
Vision HERO Increase
From the Trap Zone: summons itself, then a small Vision HERO from the Deck.
Vision HERO Gravito
Recovers a banished HERO; tributes itself to summon two Trap-Zone Vision HEROes.
Vision HERO Minimum Ray
From the Trap Zone: summons itself and destroys a small monster.
Vision HERO Poisoner
From the Trap Zone: summons itself and halves a monster's ATK.
Vision HERO Multiply Guy
From the Trap Zone: summons itself and gives 800 ATK.
Vision HERO Witch Raider
Tributes Traps to summon itself; wipes their Spells and Traps.
Vision Fusion
Fusion Summons a HERO, using Trap-Zone HEROes as material.
Vision Release
Summons a Trap-Zone Vision HERO; recovers one from the GY.
Polymerization
Untagged Fusion Spell that Vyon searches.
Apparition
Calls a small Vision HERO when your HERO is destroyed; halves a monster.
extra: Fusion of two HEROes: shrinks their monster by a HERO's ATK.
Fusion of three HEROes: doubles its ATK and attacks three times.
Allowed HERO Link-2: re-Sets Polymerization or Vision Fusion when a HERO joins it.
Level 8 Fusion: Quick Effect destroys 1 card you control and 1 card on field, and revives itself next Standby Phase.
Level 6 Fusion: banishes all cards sent to the opponent's GY and randomly banishes 1 card from their hand when they search.
